input.interpretation: An accepted result is fresh evidence that the two-group routing has sufficient mirrored lateral authority and closed-loop holding on this task; a rejected result bounds the transfer of the positive-y design and points to whether position authority or holding-speed damping is the binding constraint.

input.weakening_observation: Holding speed above 0.020 m/s or holding / terminal position error above 0.01 m (as in the historical +y T0 failure at 0.0232 m/s holding speed), non-zero solver_error count, or numerical termination before 0.35 s; any of these would show the positive-y-validated routing does not transfer to the negative-y target as-is.
